claim: For every binary length \(n\) and weight \(k\), the number containing all eight length-three scattered subsequences is \(\binom nk-3(n-2)\) for \(3\leq k\leq n-3\), and zero otherwise.
integrity: The proof and checker are self-contained except for bibliographic context. The archive records a self-review only; no independent validation or authorship claim is made.
scientific_limitations: The formula is specific to the binary alphabet and target length three; finite checker exhausts lengths through sixteen, while the symbolic proof covers all lengths. An equivalent previously published result under an unindexed formulation remains possible.
title: Composition-flat deficit for binary three-subsequence universality
